question: Which of the following Directive Principles of State Policy is provided under Article 43A of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Participation of workers in industrial management

solution:
The correct answer is __**Participation of workers in industrial management**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 43A** of the Indian Constitution was introduced by the **42nd Amendment Act** in **1976**.
 
• It directs the State to take steps to ensure the **participation of workers in the management of industries**.
 
• This provision aims to promote a sense of partnership and responsibility among workers and encourage a spirit of democratic functioning within industrial organizations.
